items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: The interviewee discusses Christiane in the third person ('she's played a lot', 'Papa used to call her his daughter') and does not claim a personal relationship with her.

ctx.x: We must interview both of them, huh?

Yes, well, uh, they'd be too glad to give you the history, because Jeanette has a wonderful history. Yeah, she's played a lot. The history of the talk, because Papa got her when she was a girl. Yeah. Yes, out of past Christiane. Papa used to call her his daughter. Yeah, Papa used to call Jeanette his daughter. She was so young when he'd taken her in the band. Yeah. And so she'd been playing the band since, on and off, I think.
Maybe she's been playing since, I didn't know.
